final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: choosing between two terminal AI coding agents in 2026, each rooted in its own ecosystem — GitHub Copilot CLI on the GitHub side and Claude Code on the Claude side. The reader should quickly feel the decision between two equally good but differently-centered tools. Summary angle: a forest crossroads with two wooden signposts — one pointing to the GitHub world, the other to the Claude world; the choice depends on which workflow defaults match your team. Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: (1) contrast — two wooden signposts at the crossroads labeled AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, pointing toward two different landscape directions; (2) mechanism — a shared wooden bridge or single open book connecting the two paths, expressing one source of truth shared by both tools; (3) takeaway — a backpacker developer silhouette standing at the center of the crossroads under warm sunlight, holding a small project checklist, choosing a path. Main metaphor: a sunlit forest crossroads where a developer picks between two worlds. Subject: a backpacker developer silhouette at the crossroads center, facing two signposts, choosing a path. Composition/framing: left-right contrast with the focal point at center; left path leads to a warm workshop-like building, right path leads to a cozy study hut; readable in a wide cover. Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: warm hand-drawn animation feeling, natural environments, gentle fantasy everyday mood, soft painterly backgrounds, no studio imitation. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: warm beige, forest green, warm orange, soft sky blue. Visible text policy: allow only 2 short labels AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md on the signposts, no more. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: terminal windows, command-line text, real product logos, HUD overlays, code rain, cyberpunk purple-blue glow, generic robot stance, speech bubbles.
